title: Prove sharp all-size endpoint defect accumulation for the balanced dirty word
body:
## Result and scope

For the unchanged PR628 balanced reserved-depth dirty word, simultaneous additive defects at every complete leaf destination have exact endpoint response counts in both orientations. The sharp target coefficient obeys `T(1)=1`, `T(n)=T(floor(n/2))+2T(ceil(n/2))`, hence `T(2^h)=3^h` despite `4^h` fully paid leaf calls. Under an ordered-subset product norm bound G and individual defects at most epsilon, final target error is at most `T(n) G epsilon`. No commutation is needed. Scalar identity factors with independent signed defects attain every row coefficient.

The written four-phase induction retains shared deeper scratch: completed later children fix it, only one of the two left-child target responses reaches the parent target, and both right-child responses do. Exact scratch counts are included; for n=8 the target coefficient is27 but the largest scratch coefficient is32. Endpoint-only accuracy must not be substituted for interior stability or whole-state accuracy.

Keeping PR1295/PR1054’s existing interior feedback, closure, inverse-preimage and preparation premises gives a conditional radix64 fractional-budget change **1,162,598 -> 1,162,590**. All4,000calls, sixdirty arrays,1,291,709signed integer bits and516,499factor bits remain paid. No selected supplier, production precision reserve, recursive profile or kappa changes.

## Evidence and reproduction

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-endpoint-error-accumulation
```

Observed on macOS arm64/CPython3.12.12, and separately replayed by the parent reviewer before publication:
- `PASS_DIRTY_ENDPOINT_ERROR_ACCUMULATION leaf_occurrences=114350 T63=727 conditional_fractional_bits=1162598->1162590 no_new_kappa`
- All endpoint responses for n=1..32,63,64,65,127,128, both orientations, bound to the unchanged source compose AST.
- Seven semantic test groups pass;430 forward free-algebra impulse responses independently agree;12 reversed noncommuting factor-order mutations are observable.
-36 exact rounded model-leaf fixtures plus their inverses,72executions total, with nonzero defects and restored dirt. These are **not actual PR1054 numerical-kernel executions**.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/dirty-endpoint-error-accumulation outcome=completed`.

Controls distinguish endpoint/interior cuts, target/scratch bounds, destination/source support, noncontractive factors, inverse chronology, missing restoration, aliases, understated counts, omitted feedback and source corruption. No selected cold replay, numerical million-bit example, physical/compiler admission, Lean or hosted CI pass is claimed. The all-size conclusion rests on the written induction, not finite extrapolation.

## Provenance, overlap and credit

Eight files only under `research/dirty-endpoint-error-accumulation/`, including complete SELECTION/TASK/SOURCES/VERIFY, exact receipt and Open next questions. Base e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a; commit add44e23b65926338707a0fd98215e0506c0f820. Independent chooser seed dc96b7ed19e1045ea40350f775120d39; adversarial-audit / uniform-transfer-audit. [Scoped claim](#research-claim-and-completion-record).

PR1855’s finite single-error/later-cut census explicitly excludes accumulation and all-size inference; the single-register interval corollary bounds one error by (h+2)G, not these sharp cumulative endpoint counts. PR1295’s commuting interval and inverse-preimage work is retained, not repeated as new. Final targeted live checks at18:29UTC confirmed the merged PR1855 and1295heads; cached full-board coverage and search limitations are recorded in README.

Credit Chafik Boukhalfa/PR628,862,905; Hanson Sun/PR1085; Charles Bethin/PR1278 and single-register transport; Arham Tahir/PR1374; woklerx/PR1855; Philipp/mightyOil/PR1295; Ali Romman/PR1054,985; Gareth Davidson/PR877;0xkilgore/PR663 and the retained lineage. New material Apache-2.0. Prepared by Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, validation and writing; parent review was also AI-assisted, not independent human or formal review.

## Research claim and completion record

Status: completed. The claim record is preserved here so this PR is self-contained. Historical coordination links in the committed research metadata refer to this record; the separate coordination discussion is being removed.

DONE — [PR2067](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2067), full commit add44e23b65926338707a0fd98215e0506c0f820. independent seed dc96b7ed19e1045ea40350f775120d39; adversarial-audit / uniform-transfer-audit; base e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a.

Established the all-size sharp endpoint target count T(1)=1, T(n)=T(floor(n/2))+2T(ceil(n/2)), hence T(2^h)=3^h despite4^h paid leaves. All-row scratch counts and both orientations are proved by the completed-child four-phase induction. Independent destination-only defects of size epsilon yield target error<=T(n)G epsilon under the ordered-subset norm bound G. Conditional PR1295/PR1054 precision substitution retains the separate interior feedback test; radix64 fractional budget1162598->1162590, all other charges unchanged.

CPython3.12.12 registered replay passed:114350source-bound leaf occurrences,T63=727,7test groups,430independent forward error-symbol responses,12noncommuting order controls.36rounded model fixtures plus their inverses passed,72executions total; no actual PR1054 numerical-kernel execution, physical/compiler admission, supplier change, Lean or new kappa claimed. Parent reviewed the proof and separately replayed before publication. All review is AI-assisted, not human peer review.
